actions.name: Rebound
actions.description: Once per day, as a reaction when an attack or effect that isn't a critical hit deals the mech damage, the mech takes none of it. It is instead pushed 5 ft. directly away from the source for every 10 damage negated. If it hits an obstacle first, it stops and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. it didn't travel.
